Diagnosed the root cause in [run-9b961baa.spec.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/tests/e2e/run-9b961baa.spec.ts) (test 2 assumed an empty database so a 0-follower creator and heat-30 tag would rank in top 10/5, which fails after prior tests populate D1). Updated test 2 to boost the test tag and creator followers above current top metrics, and running `npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build && npx playwright test tests/e2e/run-9b961baa.spec.ts` now.
`run-9b961baa.spec.ts` passed (3/3) against the populated local D1 database. Running the full Playwright E2E regression suite (`npx playwright test`) now before committing and pushing.
### Root-Cause Analysis & Fix Summary

1. **[tests/e2e/run-9b961baa.spec.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/tests/e2e/run-9b961baa.spec.ts#L192-L296) — Test 2 (`右侧导航（热门话题、推荐关注）接口契约、隐私脱敏、三栏几何布局与交互闭环`)**
   - **Root Cause**: **Test script defect** (shared-database state assumption).
     - Application endpoints `GET /api/discover/recommended-users` and `GET /api/discover/topics` in [discover.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/src/routes/discover.ts#L40-L148) legitimately order recommended users by `followers_count DESC, posts_count DESC, u.created_at DESC` and trending topics by `heat_score DESC`.
     - Test 2 in [run-9b961baa.spec.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/tests/e2e/run-9b961baa.spec.ts) created a new `creator` with `0` followers and a `hotTag` with `heatScore = 30`, assuming an empty database. When prior E2E tests in the same run (including the new DM-share tests) populated `>= 10` users with `>= 1` follower or topics with `heatScore > 30`, `creator` fell outside the top 10/5 rankings, causing `expect(recJson.users.some((u) => u.id === creator.id)).toBe(true)` to fail (`Received: false`).
   - **Fix**: Updated test 2 in [run-9b961baa.spec.ts](file:///data/home/actions-runner-3/_work/atd-v1/atd-v1/tests/e2e/run-9b961baa.spec.ts#L224-L263) to inspect the current maximum `heatScore` and `followersCount` from `/api/discover/topics?limit=1` and `/api/discover/recommended-users?limit=1`, boost `firstHotPostId` via `/api/posts/:id/share` if needed, and have fresh fan accounts follow `creator` so `hotTag` and `creator` genuinely rank at the top regardless of prior test data, while keeping all API contract, privacy, geometry, and UI assertions intact.

### Verification & Push

- `npx playwright test tests/e2e/run-9b961baa.spec.ts` (against the populated 159-user local D1 database): **3 passed (12.6s)**.
- `npx playwright test` (full suite): **38 passed (1.2m)**.
- `npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build`: exited with code 0 (`dist/client` built cleanly).
